# Live Captioner

> Live captions and optional translation for audio played on Apple silicon Macs with macOS 15 or later. Speech recognition and Apple Translation run on the Mac.

- Source, build instructions, and user guide: https://github.com/HelloLindo/live-captioner
- License: https://github.com/HelloLindo/live-captioner/blob/main/LICENSE
- Based on Parakeet by LPFchan: https://github.com/LPFchan/parakeet

Build with full Xcode 26 or later using scripts/build-app.sh, then launch with scripts/run-local.sh. Output: build/LiveCaptioner.app. Updates are installed manually.

Captions appear in a draggable floating panel. The menu bar provides caption controls, transcript copying, translation language selection, and Open at Login. Translate Screen (Shift-Command-1) reads and translates text on screen.

Caption Font Size controls translated and original captions independently from 10–36 pt, defaulting to 16 pt and 12 pt. Sizes persist after quitting and the panel adjusts its height. Original Captions also controls untranslated text.

The default speech engine is Nemotron 3.5 ASR via FluidAudio. Model and language-pack setup requires network downloads. System audio capture includes the system mix. Transcripts stay in session memory; Copy Transcript writes them to the clipboard. Screen translation needs Screen Recording permission.

The app uses the io.github.hellolindo.livecaptioner bundle identity. The MIT license and upstream attribution are preserved. Website demo assets come from upstream and do not show Live Captioner's current branding or font controls.
